sloka: तस्य पापमभिप्रायं विदित्वा पाकशासनः ।सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वाक्यमुवाच युवनाश्वजम् ।। ७.६७.९ ॥
transliteration: tasya pāpamabhiprāyaṁ viditvā pākaśāsanaḥ ।sāntvapūrvamidaṁ vākyamuvāca yuvanāśvajam ।। 7.67.9 ॥

translations.english: Knowing Mandhata's sinful intention, Indra, the slayer of Paka, spoke these conciliatory words to the son of Yuvanashva.
